meta.title: Fix memory allocation issue for large files by capping StaticSparseDAG capacity
meta.body_summary: Copilot caps StaticSparseDAG capacity to prevent memory allocation failures when processing large input files, following maintainer instructions from issue #124.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot capped StaticSparseDAG capacity to fix OOM for large files; maintainer guided cleanup and adjusted final constant.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: A small 288-line change that included temporary test files later removed; the core fix in sparse_dag.rs is only ~22 lines. The PR merged quickly after maintainer-guided cleanup.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer messense requested removal of new test files, keeping sparse_dag module private, and updating PR title/description to match the focused fix.
review_details.performance_claim: Fix memory allocation failures for large files by capping StaticSparseDAG capacity.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: A straightforward memory limit configuration in a Rust library; Copilot could implement the fix but needed maintainer guidance on tests and module visibility.

detection_detail.code_reading: messense reviewed the PR diff, instructed removal of extraneous tests and module privacy restoration, and later adjusted the capacity constant.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: The PR references issue #124 which may contain reproduction steps; within the PR itself only a narrative claim is present. CI reports show no performance regression.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After Copilot's initial fix, the maintainer directly committed an adjustment to the maximum capacity (~32MB) before merging.

core_change_summary.description: In src/sparse_dag.rs, introduced MAX_CAPACITY constant (initial 8_388_608, later updated to ~32MB) to cap StaticSparseDAG allocation; in src/lib.rs, changed sparse_dag module visibility back to private.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Test files were added then removed per maintainer request; CodSpeed CI reported no performance change.
change_trajectory: Implemented capacity cap in sparse_dag with test files and public module.
